This website is open to my students in the University of Nebraska-Lincoln's STAT 380 course. 

**Course description:** Probability calculus; random variables, their probability distributions and expected values; t, F and chi-square sampling distributions; estimation; testing of hypothesis; and regression analysis with applications.
